name: SPEED_LIMIT_CHANGED_YELLOW_SQUARE
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet T1-SA109: T1-SA109B 600 x 600 illustrated (A 450, C 900; border 10 for A and B, 15 for C). Only with R4-1 or R4-10.
